title: Changing an entry's description on the Part Library page reaches every location
custom_preconds:
Setup (manual QA tester and Claude session)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as an Admin who can pick two locations in the location selector, {Location-A} (for example Staging Heavy Duty - 9919) and {Location-B} (for example Staging Lethbridge - 4310). The Admin role has 'Part Library & Inventory → View / Create & Edit / Delete'.
  • Inventory part {Part-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-LIBDESC-01) is stocked at both locations on one Part Library entry: active at {Location-A} and inactive at {Location-B}.
  • Its saved description is {Description-A} (for example "ZZAUTOTEST PL lib desc old").
  • The new description is {Description-B} (for example "ZZAUTOTEST PL lib desc new").
custom_steps:
1. Pick {Location-A} in the location selector in the top bar.
  2. In the top bar click Parts, then click Part Library in the left menu.
  3. Type {Part-A} in the Search box.
  4. Click the {Part-A} row.
  5. Click the pencil icon beside the entry's name in the Part details panel.
  6. Replace the Description with {Description-B}.
  7. Replace the Description with two spaces, then {Description-A}, then two spaces.
  8. Replace the Description with {Description-B}.
  9. Click Save.
  10. In the top bar click Parts, then click Inventory in the left menu.
  11. Type {Part-A} in the Search box.
  12. Click the clock icon (tooltip "Part History") at the left of the {Part-A} row.
  13. Pick {Location-B} in the location selector.
  14. In the top bar click Parts, then click Inventory in the left menu.
  15. Click the Inactive tab.
  16. Type {Part-A} in the Search box, replacing any text there.
  17. Click the clock icon at the left of the {Part-A} row.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 6: Under the Description field the dialog shows "This also changes the description at 1 other location." The part at {Location-B} counts although it is inactive there.
  • Step 7: The saved description with only spaces around it is not a change: the message disappears.
  • Step 8: The message shows again.
  • Step 9: The change is saved and the detail page shows {Description-B}.
  • Step 11: At {Location-A} the part shows the description {Description-B}.
  • Step 12: Part History at {Location-A} has a new entry "Description updated | Original description: {Description-A} | New description: {Description-B}", with no "Changed at" at the end.
  • Step 16: At {Location-B} the inactive part shows {Description-B}.
  • Step 17: Part History at {Location-B} has "Description updated | Original description: {Description-A} | New description: {Description-B} | Changed at: {Location-A}", with the name of {Location-A} as the location selector shows it.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10647; story SV-10824 (Story 11, The Part Library Is Browse and Edit Only); story SV-10826 (Story 13, The Part Dialog); story SV-10823 (Story 10, Confirming and Recording a Status Change); PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, v29 (14 Oct 2026 copy), S11-R3a, S13-R12, S13-R13, S13-R14, S10-R24, S10-R25, §8 User Feedback Summary, read 14 Oct 2026; design canvas board 2.2 (Both fields edited), board 2.4 (Part History at Heavy Duty), board 2.6 (Part History at Lethbridge), board 7.2 (An entry opens its detail page), 13 Oct copy. Product's 9 Oct answer (Chris Ward, question 5). Source-verified 14 October 2026; not yet build-verified (no Part Lifecycle QA build exists).

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S11-R3a: “Changing an entry's number or description on its detail page follows the part dialog's rules: S13-R12 to S13-R19, S13-N1, S13-N7, and S10-R23 to S10-R25.”
  • S13-R12: “When the user changes the description and at least one other location stocks the same Part Library entry, the dialog shows, under the field, "This also changes the description at {n} other locations.", or "This also changes the description at 1 other location." for one.”
  • S13-R13: “That message shows only while the typed description differs from the saved one, ignoring spaces before and after it. Parts at other locations count whether they are active or inactive.”
  • S13-R14: “Saving a changed description changes the part's Part Library entry, so every location that stocks the part shows the new description.”
  • S10-R24: “A changed description writes "Description updated | Original description: {old} | New description: {new}" to the Part History of the part at every location that stocks it.”
  • S10-R25: “On the entries written at the other locations, the line ends with "| Changed at: {location}", naming the location where the change was made.”
  • PRD §8 User Feedback Summary (Description changed on a part other locations stock): “"This also changes the description at {n} other locations." ("1 other location." for one) | Text under the field while it differs”
